lesson: A quantitative identification ("defect delta implies zeros within f(delta)") on any class containing zeta at defect 0 is the target itself. What can be proved without the target is stability, which reads the functional equation and integrality, not multiplicativity. The sqrt(eps) reach is the discriminant of a function real on the line, not an arithmetic discontinuity. For a finite coefficient vector with a defective functional equation "a zero" is not defined by the data; the symmetrised functional used here builds the square-root law in and hides the linear shift mechanism (n^alpha: zeros at distance alpha, defect 1.14 alpha at X = 4000). A real-ray theta defect delta controls G only for |t| <= (4/pi) log(1/delta), so complex rays are needed. NR-q cannot be excluded through multiplicativity by any functional.
